main_text.p: mandare voluit, quantum in1.39. D. de Reg. jur. se fuit, etsi per alium mora erat, quo minus id fieret, aut quod intentum non fortiretur effectum. 4. Quia nonnunquam ex minis majus imminere, vel resultare poterit damnum, quam ex vulnere, ab illo illato, qui tantum mutilare volebat. Ut si hoc casu occidere liceat aggressorem, & illo liceat.

Ita si aggressor, aliquem minitetur sclopo, eumque habeat in parato, ut vel ad nutum cujusvis eû exoneret, nihil amplius exspectandū erit; cum non aliter aggressus se tueri valeat, quam si minantem occiderit aggressorem. Tolet. Infruct. Sacerd. 1.5, c.6.Hic enim ridiculum foret exspectare, donec minas exequutus fuisset adversarius, quod executio certam mortem esset allatura. page.notes: The marginal note "1.39. D. de Reg. jur." is printed as "1.39. D." / "de Reg." / "jur." across three lines and is shown here as one note. The note "Tolet. Infruct. Sacerd. 1.5, c.6." is printed as "Tolet.In-/ftruct./Sacerd./1.5, c.6." and is shown here as one note. Long s and the "ct" ligature were read as plain s and ct. The word "eû" is printed with a diacritic over the u and is copied as printed. Some digits in the margin notes are small and may be misread (e.g. "1.39" and "1.5").
